notes: Account: engineering-first, heavy on code search for internal dev workflows. Primary product ask = embeddings + reranker pipeline with predictable cost.

Environment: ~1.2k repos, 85M source files, estimate ~120M embeddings after dedupe. Current vector store footprint ~600GB compressed (FAISS + IVF_IVF). Frequent updates: nightly full rebuild + hourly syncs for active repos.
POC scope: evaluate Redwood Private (VPC) and Dedicated options for throughput/cost tradeoffs. Also want Optimize recommendations for quantization and batching tuned to code tokens.
Latency targets: p95 query latency <= 150ms for dev interactive flows; preferred p95 <= 100ms. Throughput target: 300 qps peak for internal CI-related queries.
Cost sensitivity: looking for <$0.002 per embedding-query-equivalent (combined retriever+reranker). Requesting modeled cost spreadsheet across batching, caching, quantization profiles.
Security: must support SSO/SAML (Okta), tenant-level KMS integration, audit logs pushed to SIEM, retention controls for embeddings. Data residency preference: US-only for now.

Integration notes: will run retriever (ANN) in Rust microservice and call Redwood for reranking/generation. Need SDK-level language support (Go, Python) and simple fallback rules when Dedicated capacity is exhausted.
Reindexing requirements: incremental updates should be possible with sub-hour latency for high churn services. Want suggestions for delta ingestion patterns and shard-level rollouts.
Stakeholders: CTO (Maria Solis) cares about cost & control; Head of Search (Evan Kim) cares about latency and rerank quality; Security (Nina Patel) owns SSO/KMS signoff.
Quote from demo: "Nice latency numbers, but we need a concrete reindex plan and SSO mock before we can go to procurement." — Evan K.

Technical constraints: on-prem CI runners cannot reach public endpoints; require Private control plane option or Dedicated with VPC peering. Also require drift detection for embedding quality regressions.
Proof points asked for: 1) p95 latency at 300 qps on quantized model, 2) cost per 10k queries across caching scenarios, 3) reindex time for 10M docs per hour pipeline.
Docs requested by SE: architecture doc template, default canary rollout plan, sample SAML SSO integration steps. See drive links above.
Next POC step: run full-scale rerank benchmark (50k queries) against their sample corpus and compare Redwood-hosted reranker vs on-prem reranker using Redwood serving for embeddings only.
Commercial: prefer 12–24 month committed Dedicated pricing if POC meets SLA; otherwise start hosted API pilot with Optimize add-on. Initial ARR ask ~150k/yr.
Keepalive: weekly syncs with AE + SE on Fridays; security deep-dive scheduled 2026-03-15 if POC metrics pass threshold.
